marks_per_question.description: Default available marks for questions without a marks override; defaults to 1.

allow_negative_mark.description: Whether scores can go below zero (alias: negative_marks)

title.description: Falls back to this if the top-level title is absent

default_question_count.description: Pre-fill the question count input on the config screen

QuizQuestion.description: Multiple-choice or unmarked short-answer question. IDs must be unique within the quiz.

question.description: Question text displayed to the user

correct_answers.description: Required for multiple choice: one or more correct strings (alias: correctAnswers). Omit or leave empty for short answers.

incorrect_answers.description: Required for multiple choice: wrong strings, may be empty (alias: incorrectAnswers). Omit or leave empty for short answers.

explanation.description: Explanation shown after submission (alias for metadata.explanation)

type.description: Omit for multiple choice; short_answer accepts unmarked text without answer options.

marks.description: Positive available marks; overrides the quiz default, including fractional values.

hints.description: Optional plain-text hints, hidden until clicked. Empty or omitted means no hint controls. Usage is recorded without a score penalty.

images.description: Ordered prompt images, shared by multiple-choice and short-answer questions. Local paths require a ZIP; standalone JSON requires HTTPS URLs.

study_location.description: Where this topic was taught (e.g. 'Week 3'). Used by location filter.

topic.description: Subject area of the question. Used by topic filter.

timestamp.description: Timestamp or reference (shown in study info panel)

answer.description: Original answer key reference (shown in study info panel)

notes.description: Additional study notes (shown if no explanation)

src.description: HTTPS URL without credentials, or an exact case-sensitive path relative to the ZIP root (e.g. photo.png or figures/photo.jpg).

alt.description: Required nonblank alternative text describing the figure.

caption.description: Optional plain-text caption shown below the image.
